intro: Five forced choices. You land on one operating tension — and the orgs that already live that bet.

questions.prompt: Who should own the product craft day to day?

a.label: Engineers own problem, priority, and ship — strategy fights live in grooming

b.label: A PM owns the product surface; engineering delivers against that bet

questions.prompt: When do you invest in polish?

a.label: Keep tools ugly until the market answers — process comes after demand

b.label: Design from the user job now — even when AI makes mediocre interfaces cheap

questions.prompt: At scale, how do you keep the product coherent?

a.label: Mission swarms and radical autonomy — hierarchy is the bottleneck

b.label: Pull strategy up — VP-centered bets beat squad freedom that frays the experience

questions.prompt: How should a company unlock its data?

a.label: Let domain experts explore without a data-science gatekeeper

b.label: Prep, govern, and integrate ops before AI can take working hours

questions.prompt: What is community for in a product business?

a.label: Community is the product — curated connections beat placements alone

b.label: Community is positioning infrastructure — consulting rides the halo
